facts.fact: JoyNews' Emmanuel Samani writes that none of the people he interviewed could point to a Ghanaian rule governing how AI enters a hospital, who checks it or what happens when it is wrong, with clinical-software approval in a grey zone.

GHA.note: Only AI in health facilities; no general administration use stated.

facts.fact: Samani writes that Ghanaian companies and researchers are building diagnostic models domestically on local data, naming MinoHealth in Accra and MorphoAI at the University for Development Studies, with no release stated.
Samani writes that Ghana's Data Protection Commission only began enforcement spot checks in October 2026, so the body is acting.
